description: Get the scene hierarchy as a nested tree of { name, type, path, script, children }. Use maxDepth:1 for a shallow listing of direct children only; default -1 returns the full tree. parentPath scopes the result to a subtree. Returns the nested tree as JSON text. Errors if scene does not exist or parentPath is not found.

maxDepth.description: Maximum recursion depth. -1 for unlimited (default: -1). 1 returns only direct children.

parentPath.description: Scope to a subtree starting at this node path (e.g. "root/Player")

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: get_scene_tree
